summary.text: Dianne Mitchell is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 21, having assumed office on December 23, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as teaching music and art.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell was born in Greenville, South Carolina, and earned a high school diploma from Wade Hampton High School, a bachelor's degree from Furman University and a graduate degree from Indiana University.

Her career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes teaching music and art, and she has been affiliated with the Community Character Council, Centre Stage, Greenville Little Theatre, the South Carolina Children's Theatre and the Greenville Republican Women's Club.
Mitchell succeeded Bobby Cox in the seat, and she defeated Heather Currie in the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists Dexter Reaves, a Democrat, as her general-election opponent.
